title: Time to Roll Up My Sleeves…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It's still a bit early, but I think I'll hop to it and prep for training—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's up? You sound like you're in a pinch.

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Palmer! Um… Well, my friends and I were supposed to do some fieldwork today…

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: But everyone else who was supposed to help got sick and can't come. How am I supposed to handle this all on my ooown?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, okay. How 'bout I lend you a hand? I'm only one person, but even one extra helper's better than none, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Sure. When it comes to digging in the dirt, I'm your gal! Let's head over right now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (There's still time before training, so I should be fine as long as I wrap this up fast and get back in time!)

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Whoa! You're the best tiller I've ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The fields are looking good, right? C'mon, let's keep going!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer gets so absorbed in helping the younger Umamusume that she forgets all about training.
